title: Panopticon Silver Conformed Measurements Schema
description: Cleansed, normalized, PII-sanitized, and Citizen-Lab-enriched schema contract for silver_network_measurements

metadata.comment: PK: OONI measurement_uid when present, else length-prefixed SHA-256 of the 6 Bronze natural-key parts
Foreign provenance key back to OONI raw probe
Standardized UTC timestamp of measurement start
Physical partition column (YYYY-MM-DD)
Sanitized target URL with authentication tokens and query credentials scrubbed
Clean second-level domain name (e.g. bbc.com) used for joins
Cleaned numeric Autonomous System Number (e.g. 9541, defaults to 0L if unknown)
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code
Normalized telecom provider / ISP name
/24 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6) mask; NULL when the source IP is loopback/unspecified
HMAC-SHA256(pepper, resolver_ip); NULL for empty/loopback resolvers
Cleaned numeric resolver ASN
Network test name
Raw anomaly flag asserted by OONI client test engine
Raw confirmed censorship flag asserted by OONI API metadata
Synthesized multi-signal interference indicator flag
Multi-signal classification status: CONFIRMED_BLOCKED, HEURISTIC_ANOMALY, BENIGN, UNCLASSIFIED
Classification: DNS_TAMPERING, TCP_RESET, TLS_DROP, HTTP_BLOCK, BENIGN, ANOMALY_UNCLASSIFIED, UNCLASSIFIED
1 if DNS tampering detected, else 0
1 if TCP reset / block detected, else 0
1 if TLS handshake interference detected, else 0
1 if HTTP block page status detected, else 0
DNS failure message
HTTP failure message
Execution duration in seconds (renamed from duration_seconds / response_latency_ms)
Citizen Lab category code (NEWS, POL, CIRCUMVENTION, UNCATEGORIZED)
Human-readable Citizen Lab category description
Citizen Lab match tier: EXACT_URL, DOMAIN_FALLBACK, or UNMATCHED
Citizen Lab taxonomy version commit SHA or release tag
Risk assessment tier: HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
Audit: UTC timestamp when record was upserted into Silver
Audit: Processing batch identifier
